fact_text: Wafi Energy's Tameer Awards 2025 drew more than 450 applications from young entrepreneurs across Pakistan, and 30 of them qualified as finalists.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wafi Energy Tameer Awards 2025: Top Next-Gen Innovators | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-17)

fact_text: Selected Tameer Awards 2025 finalists presented their ideas to industry experts and judges at the event.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wafi Energy Tameer Awards 2025: Top Next-Gen Innovators | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-17)

fact_text: Tameer, Wafi's social investment programme, has run for more than 20 years and has provided guidance and support to over 1 million young people.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wafi Energy Tameer Awards 2025: Top Next-Gen Innovators | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-17)

fact_text: Agriclassis turns industrial marble-processing waste into a liquid calcium fertiliser and placed in the circular-economy category of the Tameer Awards 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wafi Energy Tameer Awards 2025: Top Next-Gen Innovators | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-17)

fact_text: Biome Energy won the clean energy solutions award at the Tameer Awards 2025 for household and small-scale biogas units that convert organic waste into fuel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wafi Energy Tameer Awards 2025: Top Next-Gen Innovators | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-17)
